repository_validation.environment: Windows Python 3.12; local test sockets enabled, freshly composed pinned JavaScript/mobile site

board_effects: Authorized RAM loads and two revision-8 boot installations reset the P2 and replace disposable project code. Initial aaf82995 boot image passed DMA but exposed an external-capture startup transient. Final 5189b980 image includes explicit startup discard and passed all ten flash-boot suites, including USB --reboot and stored CRCs. Final VM soft reset releases outputs/stops workers. No Windows browser interaction.
verified_behavior: FCACHE-only streamer/WRFAST loop publishes complete 512-byte pages; FBLOCK chooses a free next page; two-page reserve prevents overwriting unread data. XSTOP and FIFO drain precede HUB execution.

Full-clock deterministic 4096/8192/24576-bit records and 24576-bit retained overflow; divided continuous pattern across wrap/five GCs and concurrent worker progress. Worker byte-array/density service has exact graceful-stop accounting.

Pretrigger overwrites old history while armed and refuses reads, then retains chronological pre/post pages after a high/low page-boundary level match. Timeout exposes retained partial history; trigger/data release, cog/stop-all/edit cancellation and guards pass.
Raw ADC ground/VIO and four high-impedance DAC-to-ADC1x density responses; vector density 13/32 bits equals 406250 ppm. These are transfer/density observations.

Managed external raw bit capture now discards one completed startup snapshot. A physical failure prefix contained one inconsistent first bit; six fresh startup cases at 20/62.5/1000 kHz verify all retained bits. Finite external counts exclude the discarded startup word.
Test fixes: restart the pattern source after releasing it between trigger-level cases; use the existing three-argument DAC8 API with the named circuit. No generic VM or transport changes.
remaining_limits: Trigger level is sampled at 4096-sample page boundaries; short pulses may be missed. Sample-accurate edge timing remains software work and is not independently instrumented.
DMA exposes one input and system-clock power-of-two divisors. External-clock/multi-pin DMA are not exposed; divided raw ADC samples may alias and are not SINC-filtered values.

One capture session; ordinary rings have 1023 usable entries, DMA retains 768 words without a consumer. The 115200-baud link cannot sustain the 22.5 MB/s full-clock source; a faster sink and driver are required.

USB operating mode 27 requires separate DM/DP wiring, safe VBUS and a protocol stack; never attempted on hard-short pairs. External UART/SPI/ADC devices, actual SMPS circuitry and independent analog/clock performance require appropriate hardware/instruments.

Prior Edge Connect target USB/native chooser stopped under URL-policy guard because current Windows browser URL could not be determined confidently. Outcome remains uncertain; no browser inspection, retry or alternate route. Revision-8 graphical board execution unverified.
